evidence_quotes.their_agenda: NOT ASKED — Nicole moved directly into logistics probing without ever asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer for follow-up
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised; no reflection opportunity
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Property type: house to house (covered). Stories: 2-story to 1-story (covered). Rooms: not clearly asked. Walking distance: 'ten minute drive' (mentioned). Additional rooms/spaces: garage, backyard covered. Special considerations: partial — customer mentioned assembling/disassembling furniture but Nicole prompted this rather than discovering unprompted.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: NOT OFFERED — Nicole mentioned wrap and blankets but never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full range given: '$1,224 to $1,428' with typical size reference (1900 sq ft, 6-7 hours, two movers, one truck). Personalized to customer's statement of no boxes, only furniture, and mention of disassembly/reassembly.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full transparency: $102 per hour per mover (explained clearly), no hidden fees (explicitly named: no credit card fees, no transportation fees, no sterile fees, no disassemble/reassembly fees). Minimum 2.5 hours, time prorated in 15-minute increments (stated). All included (fuel, truck, taxes, insurance, wrap, pads, tools, assembly/reassembly) — complete.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: NOT ASKED — Nicole moved directly into defending the estimate ('I know 6 to seven but keep in mind we are a time based company') without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or holding any pause.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: FULL — 'if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill' — discount terms clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: FULL — 'we have no worries, damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages' — coverage amount and no-deductible framing (implied by 'repair, replace or reimburse') clear. No mention of 'built into the rate' but coverage itself is fully delivered.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: NO — Nicole never asked 'Does that put those to rest?' or any version of confirming the two promises resolved customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: NOT ASKED — call ends abruptly when customer says 'It's not gonna take that' and 'Okay, thank you, I appreciate your help. Have a good day.' Nicole says 'You're welcome and.' — no genuine concerns check like 'What's still concerning you?' ever happened.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: NEVER — Nicole never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' The call ends with the customer disconnecting after pushback on the estimate.

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floors, additional rooms, backyard items, appliances) and delivered complete pricing transparency upfront, including all fees and the 2.5-hour minimum with 15-minute increments.
coaching_note: Ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' early (Section 2) before any probing, and always confirm the estimate feels fair with genuine silence before defending the hours — the customer's objection ('It's not gonna take six to seven hours') signals you missed the chance to listen and address concerns, which led to call abandonment.
